home.goal: The goal: challenge each other on the slopes, earn points, and finish the trip with the best score 🏔️

cards.title: The cards
cards.rule1: There are 15 cards: 5 🟩 Challenge, 5 🟦 Good conduct, 5 🟥 Constraint.
cards.rule2: Each day, you receive 3 new cards (1 of each color), different ones.
cards.rule3: You keep your cards as long as you don't use them: you can have more than 3 if you play well.

send.title: Send a challenge
send.rule1: You choose a card from My hand, then send it to a member.
send.rule2: The recipient sees who sent them the challenge.
send.rule3: Anti-spam rule: you can't send 2 challenges of the same type to the same person on the same day (e.g., 2 good conducts).

result.title: Success / Failure
result.validated: If the challenge is validated, you earn points:
result.failed: If the challenge is failed, you don't earn points.
result.daily: So everyone can play: you always have at least 3 cards per day to send.

ranking.title: Ranking & badges
ranking.multipleOr: In a group, multiple people can be "GOLD": the score decides.
ranking.greenBonus: Bonus: whoever has the most eco challenges becomes 🌱 Green Skier.
